settings.title: Improper Ear Care Leads to Uncomfortable Buildup
settings.text:
Our ears naturally produce wax to protect against dust and debris, but traditional cleaning tools like Q-tips often pack this wax tightly against the eardrum rather than extracting it.

Over time, this compacted buildup can cause annoying itching, muffled hearing, ringing, and even painful ear infections.

settings.heading: Is the SONEASE hair therapy safe?
settings.row_content: Yes! The SONEASE Anti-Hair Loss Cap uses non-invasive, low-level light technology that is completely safe and gentle on your scalp. It is a heat-free treatment designed for regular, worry-free home use.

settings.heading: Does using the device hurt?
settings.row_content: Not at all. The treatment is completely painless. There is no burning or uncomfortable warming sensation—just a lightweight, comfortable hat you can wear while relaxing, working, or watching TV.

settings.heading: Who should NOT use this device?
settings.row_content: While safe for most adults experiencing pattern baldness or hair thinning, we recommend consulting with your doctor before use if you have severe scalp infections, are taking medications that cause extreme light sensitivity, or are currently pregnant.

settings.heading: Can I wash the SONEASE cap?
settings.row_content: The electronic therapy insert is not waterproof and should never be submerged in water. However, the outer fabric hat can typically be spot-cleaned with a damp cloth once the electronic components are safely removed.
